description: Service de visualisation cartographique (WMS) de carte : Téléphonie mobile is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto2.geo-ide.din.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Implantation of mobile phone pylones, ARCEP data:. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Viewing Service (WMS): Mobile telephony" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 2022-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
